messages:
alex (PM): Quick sync — I'm drafting a compact PRD for staged exposure of the new routing policy (model-v2-weighted). Need to lock acceptance criteria, ramp plan, and rollback triggers before RFC. Posting a short draft here to iterate.

maya (Eng): SG. Please include concrete ramp steps, per-step safety checks, and how tenant overrides work.

alex (PM): Draft ramp plan: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~72h (adjustable). Safety checks at each step: latency_p95 <= 1.3x baseline; error_rate_delta <= +0.2% absolute. Fail any check -> immediate cut to 0% and fallback to model-v1. Avoid final 50% step during peak regional windows.

jordan (Data): Metrics to capture: p50/p95 latency, request_success_rate, error_rate, streaming_stalls, hallucination_flag_rate (from eval hooks), avg_generated_tokens, cost_per_1k_tokens. Slice by customer_tier and by session_type (stream vs bulk).

sophie (Ops): From infra side: rollout must be controlled by a feature-flag + traffic-split resource and include an admin "force-fallback" toggle. We need autoscale headroom defined for model-v2 (memory and GPU pool); without headroom we should block the 20% -> 50% jump. Add audit logs on traffic changes.

alex (PM): Edge cases I listed: short requests (<50 tokens), long-context sessions (KV cache hit patterns), and streaming sessions that keep connections open >30s. Acceptance criteria additions: streaming_stalls increase <= 5% vs baseline; enterprise customer SLA unchanged.

maya (Eng): Config idea (example to include in RFC):
```json
{
  "experiment_id": "exp-20260320-1",
  "steps": [
    {"percent": 1, "duration": "6h"},
    {"percent": 5, "duration": "12h"},
    {"percent": 20, "duration": "24h"},
    {"percent": 50, "duration": "rest_of_experiment"}
  ],
  "safety_checks": {
    "latency_p95_ratio": 1.3,
    "error_rate_delta_abs": 0.002,
    "streaming_stalls_delta_pct": 0.05
  },
  "auto_rollback": true,
  "tenant_override_policy": "tier_exemptions + explicit_opt_out"
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy: rollout job queued for model-v2-exposure; plan_id=exp-20260320-1; status=queued :white_check_mark:

alex (PM): Quick question — do we allow tenant-level pin overrides by default? My proposal: enterprise tier = opt-out protected (stays on v1 unless sales/CS opt them in); others default into the experiment unless opted out.

sophie (Ops): Ops prefers auto-exempt for customer_tier == "enterprise" and audit log + email notify on any tenant change. Also require a manual checklist for first 20% step.

jordan (Data): Analysis plan: run A/B cohort comparison with matched traffic for 7 days post-50% to reach statistical power. Pre-register primary metric: latency-adjusted quality score (QA_score) and secondary: cost_per_call. We'll provide a dashboard with cohort deltas per hour.

maya (Eng): I'll implement an automatic rollback hook: if p95_latency > threshold for a sustained 10-minute window OR error_rate increases >0.5% absolute over 5 minutes -> cut traffic for experiment to 0% and trigger paging. Also implement a 'soft-fallback' mode (route new sessions to v1 but allow already-streaming sessions to finish).

alex (PM): Great. I'll fold these into the PRD and attach a short RFC draft. Action items: maya adds config + rollback hooks, jordan prepares pre-registered analysis, sophie writes runbook steps and manual checklist for 20% cutover, I'll schedule a 30m sync and tag the customer success owners for enterprise exemptions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
